# Terminal — Style Prompt

> A dark code-editor window fills the frame and everything happens inside it, as if someone were working in a real terminal. Each line types itself in letter by letter, every letter flickering through two random green glyphs before it settles; a green block caret blinks at the end of the headline, a blue selection sweeps over the key figure the way a mouse marks text, steps run as `$` prompt lines that tick green, and a big monospace figure spins through random digits before it locks left to right. Scenes leave by hard cuts: a three-frame glitch slice with green bars, then a beat of empty window.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **a screen, not a page**: one fixed editor window on a near-black ground, a mono label over each idea, one heavy headline, at most three prompt lines or one giant figure, and generous empty surface below. Text is never placed, it is *typed*: scramble, lock, caret. Emphasis is a **selection** (blue block behind the word), not a colour change or an underline. Green means done (the prompt, the caret, the tick, the scramble flicker), orange means a reminder, blue means selected; nothing else carries colour.

Not cartoon (no stickers, no rounded bounce, no overshoot), not a dissolve film (scenes never cross-fade: they cut, through a glitch slice or straight to an empty window), not hacker kitsch (no falling code rain, no green-on-black CRT text, no skulls), not a busy dashboard (one idea per screen, never a wall of code), not a real product's interface (no recognisable app chrome, logos or menus: three grey dots on a bar are enough).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Ground**: flat `--latar`, a 3 px scanline pattern (1 px line of 3.5% `--teks` every 3 px), and a vignette (ellipse 130% × 90% at 50% 45%, clear to 55%, about 40% black at the edge). Both drawn once and never moved.
- **The window**: inset 60 px left and right, from y 360 to y 1500 (420 px above the bottom), radius 18 px, 1 px `--garis` border, filled `--latar-2`. A 58 px title bar with a 1 px bottom line and three 14 px dots in `--garis`, 12 px apart, 24 px from the left. The window never moves, scales or flickers; only its content changes.
- **Content column**: x 80 to 1000. Archetypes: *chapter* (top 440: number, title, rule, label), *head + list* (head top 420, list top 820), *stat* (top 600: figure, unit, note).
- **Rules**: 3 px `--teks` at 85% under a chapter title (30 px below it); 2 px `--garis` under each list row.
- **Block caret**: 0.5em × 0.95em, `--utama-di-latar`, 0.08em after the last letter, sunk 0.1em.
- **Selection**: a block of 40% `--aksen` behind the word, 0.06em padding each side, full line height.
- **Sign-off**: bottom-left at 300 px from the bottom: a 22 px mono label inside the window's foot, below it a 54 px name with a 34 px mono tagline, then five 34 px swatch dots (ground, text, main, purple, orange) with a 1 px `--garis` ring.
- **Glitch bars**: four full-width bars of `--utama` at 18%, 43%, 61% and 77% of the height, 12, 21, 30 and 39 px tall, 90% opacity, only during a cut.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground around the window (the source's near-black #0D1117). `--latar-2`: the window surface (#161B22), one small step lighter.
- `--garis` (look token, 15% `--teks` mixed into `--latar-2`): window border, title-bar dots, row rules, swatch rings.
- `--utama` plays the **success green**: the glitch bars are `--utama`; every green mark on the surface goes through `--utama-di-latar`: the chapter number, the `$` prompts, the block caret, the scramble flicker, the ticks. On a pale brand it falls back to the text colour and the look stays legible.
- `--aksen` plays the **selection blue**, only as the 40% fill behind a selected word (`--pilih`). The word on it stays `--teks`.
- `--teks`: headlines, list lines, the locked figure, selected words. `--teks-redup`: mono labels, notes, the sign-off tagline, and the digits while they scramble.
- `--teks-di-utama`: any label set on a green field (a key cap, a filled status chip); `--teks-di-aksen` on a solid blue one.
- Fixed in every brand: purple `#A371F7` and orange `#F0883E` (the swatch row). Orange is the only reminder colour; as text it is mixed 74% with `--teks` (`--pengingat`) so it reads on light and dark grounds. Never use green for a warning or orange for success.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries headlines and list lines, heavy: Inter 800 with a 0.014em stroke in the text colour, which brings it to the source's black weight. Chapter title 120 px, headline 92 px, list line 70 px, figure unit 100 px; line height 1.04, tracking −0.01em, never broken inside a word. Keep a title to one or two short lines (no `text-wrap: balance`: it re-runs on every typed letter). With a wider brand face keep the words short rather than shrinking.
- `--font-isi` carries notes and small body: Inter 400 at 44 px in `--teks-redup`.
- The **mono** (look token `--font-kode`: IBM Plex Mono) stays in every brand, because the terminal is its material: chapter number 600 at 200 px (line height 0.9, tracking −0.04em, a 5 px stroke for weight), the figure 600 at 300 px (tracking −0.05em, suffix at 0.42em on the cap line), `$` prompts 600 at 30 px, labels 400 at 26 px uppercase +0.04em, the sign-off label 22 px +0.2em. The scramble glyphs are drawn in this mono too, whatever the line's own face.
- Without brand fonts, other headline faces that suit: Space Grotesk 700, Archivo Black, Noto Sans Bold, Poppins 800. Avoid serif and handwriting faces; never set a headline in the mono.
- Copy: one headline of 2-4 words per screen, list lines under ~20 characters, notes one line. Figures in id-ID form (62,4%).

## 5. Motion quality

- **Eases**: enter `power3.out`, exit `power4.in`, snap `power4.inOut`, no overshoot anywhere.
- **Type-scramble**: letters 0.03 s apart (a long line capped at 0.5 s in total); each letter appears as a random glyph from `01#_/<>{}[]*+=~%$&` in the green, swaps to another after 0.05 s, and locks to the real letter at 0.1 s. Not-yet-typed letters keep their space (lines never reflow), except a line with a caret, where they take none so the caret rides the last letter.
- **Caret**: blinks every 0.53 s, from the moment its line starts typing until the scene leaves (on the ending, until the last frame).
- **Selection**: 0.2-0.6 s after its line locks, it grows from 0 to 100% of the word's width in 0.3 s, `steps(6)` (visible stepping, like a drag), then stays.
- **Prompt lines**: the `$` appears at once, its text starts typing 0.08 s later, lines start 0.45-0.5 s apart, the green tick appears 0.06 s after the line locks.
- **Scramble-lock figure**: fades in over 0.3 s; every digit (the decimal mark too) shows a random digit in `--teks-redup` every 0.05 s, then locks to its real value at +0.35 s, +0.45 s, +0.55 s … left to right, turning `--teks`. Unit types in 0.4 s after the last lock, the note 0.4 s after that.
- **Exit**: each element goes out in 0.1 s, 0.05 s apart, `power4.in`; the glitch slice starts while the last one is still half visible; then about 0.3 s of empty window before the next scene types in.
- **Glitch slice**: four frames at 30 fps: content shifted x 26, −34, 14, 0 px with skewX 6°, −9°, 3°, 0°, a 7 px purple/green RGB split on the first three, the four bars jumping ±150 px each frame and gone on the fourth.
- **Rhythm** (measured): chapter beat 2.6 s (number at 0.25 s, title at 0.5 s, rule at 1.0 s, label at 1.15 s), list beat 5 s (lines start 1.2 s in, all locked by 2.3 s, then held), figure beat 3.5 s; holds 1.5-2.3 s after the last lock; the ending holds at least 2 s with only the caret blinking.

## 6. Camera grammar

The window is the camera: it stays locked. Changes of shot are cuts.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame, text typing in | live work, someone at the keyboard right now | every beat |
| Glitch slice (4 frames, bars + RGB split) | a jump to the next screen, a command executed | chapter changes, before a figure or the ending |
| Empty window for 0.3 s | a breath, the screen clears | after a glitch, before the punchline |
| Selection sweep | "look at this one" without moving the camera | the key figure, the price, the word that matters |
| Zoom to region (push 1.0 → 1.15 toward the active line in 0.5 s `power3.out`, the rest dimmed to 60%) | focusing on one line of a long log | a screen recording, a code detail, one row of a table |
| Punch (scale 1.12 → 1 in 0.27 s `power2.out`) | a hit landing | the locked figure, a final verdict (use once) |

## 7. Native moves

- **Type-and-scramble.** Every line arrives letter by letter, each letter flickering through green glyphs before it settles. *Fits content like:* a repair shop's "Tuts seret?"; a coding class's lesson title; a creator's episode name in a build log; the first line of a short mystery told as a case file.
- **The blinking block caret.** A green block rides the end of the headline and keeps blinking while the screen holds, so a still screen still feels live. *Fits content like:* a question to the viewer; a phone number on the ending; a password-style reveal in a story; "Daftar sekarang" for a workshop.
- **Selection sweep.** A blue block steps across the one figure or word that matters, like text marked with a mouse. *Fits content like:* the "3" in "3 langkah"; the sample size under a statistic; the price of a service package; the clue word in a story.
- **Prompt lines that tick.** `$` lines type in one after another and each gets a green tick when done. *Fits content like:* the steps of a keyboard service; a course syllabus; a creator's upload checklist; what a hotel booking includes; the stages of a hero's plan.
- **Scramble-lock figure.** A giant mono figure spins through random grey digits and locks left to right into the real value, then its unit and note type in. *Fits content like:* "62,4% lebih senyap"; a channel's subscriber milestone; a class's pass rate; the hours a story's character has left.
- **Glitch-slice cut.** The screen jolts sideways for three frames with green bars and a colour split, then clears to an empty window. *Fits content like:* the jump from problem to solution; "sebelum → sesudah"; a chapter break in a tutorial; a plot twist.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **No dissolves.** Never cross-fade two screens; cut through the glitch or through the empty window.
- **Colour meanings are strict.** Green only for success and live marks, orange only for a reminder, blue only for selection. A second accent colour breaks the look.
- **No bounce.** No back or elastic eases, no rotation, no pops: things appear (scramble, set) or snap.
- **Reflow.** Untyped letters must keep their space on multi-line text, otherwise lines rebalance as they type. Only single caret lines collapse untyped letters.
- **Scramble glyph width.** Draw the scramble glyphs in the mono and keep figures in the mono, so locking a digit never shifts its neighbours.
- **Performance (live preview).** The source blurs the figure in (10 px): do not animate blur, fade it in instead. Keep the textures static; the RGB-split text shadow lives only on the three glitch frames. Typing is many tiny `set`s on small spans: fine, but split only the lines that type, give each scene `contain: layout paint`, and put the full-frame textures on their own layer (`will-change: transform`) so a changing letter never repaints a full-screen gradient.
- **Too much text.** One headline and at most three lines per screen; long sentences make the typing crawl (cap a line at 0.5 s).
- **Safe zones.** Everything that matters sits inside the window between y 420 and 1450. The sign-off at the foot is decoration: never put the contact or price there.
- **Light brands.** The window turns almost white: the `--garis` border keeps its edge, the vignette stays at or under 40%, green marks fall back to the text colour. Check the selection still shows behind dark text.
- **Fake interfaces.** No real app names, logos, file paths of real products or menu bars; three dots are the whole chrome.

# Terminal: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3.4, long 5.

## hook

- en: a mono chapter number and the title type in from scrambled green glyphs; a rule draws under them, a mono label follows
- id: nomor bab mono dan judul diketik dari karakter acak hijau; garis ditarik di bawahnya, label mono menyusul

## problem

- en: the trouble types in as a $ line, then an orange ! reminder line types under it; the caret keeps blinking
- id: masalahnya diketik sebagai baris $, lalu baris pengingat ! oranye di bawahnya; kursor terus berkedip

## fact

- en: a mono label and one headline type in with a blinking block caret; the key word gets a blue selection
- id: label mono dan satu judul diketik dengan kursor blok berkedip; kata kuncinya diblok biru

## step

- en: headline with caret, then one $ prompt line per step typed 0.5 s apart, each ticked green when done
- id: judul berkursor, lalu satu baris prompt $ per langkah diketik berjarak 0,5 dtk, tiap baris dicentang hijau

## compare

- en: two $ lines typed one under the other; the weaker one dims to grey, the better one gets the blue selection
- id: dua baris $ diketik bersusun; yang kalah meredup abu-abu, yang menang diblok biru

## number

- en: a huge mono figure: digits flicker random in grey, then lock left to right; unit and note type in, the sample is selected
- id: angka mono raksasa: digit berganti acak abu-abu lalu terkunci kiri ke kanan; satuan dan catatan diketik, sampel diblok

## proof

- en: a source or log line types in mono under the claim; the figure that proves it gets the blue selection
- id: baris sumber atau log diketik mono di bawah klaim; angka buktinya diblok biru

## offer

- en: the offer types in as a headline; the price is selected in blue and a green ✓ line confirms what is included
- id: penawaran diketik sebagai judul; harganya diblok biru dan baris ✓ hijau menegaskan isinya

## cta

- en: name types in over a rule, the contact appears on a $ prompt with a block caret that keeps blinking, held 2 s
- id: nama diketik di atas garis, kontak muncul di baris prompt $ dengan kursor yang terus berkedip, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the result types in as one headline under a rule, a green ✓ line closes it, the caret blinks, held 2 s
- id: hasilnya diketik sebagai satu judul di atas garis, baris ✓ hijau menutupnya, kursor berkedip, diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Terminal</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Hijau sukses = --utama, biru seleksi = --aksen.
         Sesudahnya milik tampilan terminal: huruf mono, garis jendela, warna seleksi, ungu dan oranye tetap, garis pindai, vinyet. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0d1117; --latar-2: #161b22; --utama: #3fb950; --aksen: #388bfd;
        --teks: #e6edf3; --teks-redup: #8b949e; --teks-di-utama: #0d1117;
        --teks-di-aksen: #0d1117; --utama-di-latar: #3fb950; --aksen-di-latar: #58a6ff;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        --garis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 15%, var(--latar-2));
        --pilih: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 42%, transparent);
        --ungu: #a371f7; --oranye: #f0883e;
        --pengingat: color-mix(in oklab, var(--oranye) 74%, var(--teks));
        --pindai: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 3.5%, transparent);
        --vinyet: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 40%, black) 38%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      /* Jendela terminal: digambar sekali, tidak pernah bergerak. */
      #win { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; top: 360px; bottom: 420px; border: 1px solid var(--garis);
        border-radius: 18px; background: var(--latar-2); }
      #win .bar { height: 58px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--garis); display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; }
      #win .bar i { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--garis); }
      /* Tekstur di lapisan komposit sendiri: digambar sekali, huruf yang berubah di bawahnya tidak menggambar ulang gradasinya. */
      .tex { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform; }
      #scan { background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 2px, var(--pindai) 2px 3px); }
      #vig { background: radial-gradient(130% 90% at 50% 45%, transparent 55%, var(--vinyet)); }

      /* Peran huruf: judul tebal, label mono kapital redup, angka mono. */
      /* Garis tepi tipis menebalkan judul ke rasa "black" seperti sumbernya (statis, murah). */
      .judul { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.04;
        word-break: keep-all; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.014em currentColor; }
      .lbl { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 400; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .wd { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; }
      .ch { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; opacity: 0; }
      .ch[data-s="1"] { color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; }
      .flow .ch { display: none; }
      /* Seleksi: kotak biru seperti teks yang diblok mouse, melebar dalam 6 langkah. */
      .sel { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--pilih), var(--pilih)); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 0 50%;
        background-size: 0% 100%; padding: 0 0.06em; }
      .caret { display: inline-block; width: 0.5em; height: 0.95em; background: var(--utama-di-latar); vertical-align: -0.1em;
        margin-left: 0.08em; opacity: 0; }

      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; visibility: hidden; contain: layout paint; }
      .scene[data-g="1"] { text-shadow: -7px 0 0 var(--ungu), 7px 0 0 var(--utama); }
      .rule { height: 3px; width: 100%; background: var(--teks); opacity: 0.85; transform-origin: 0 50%; }
      /* Bab (pembuka dan penutup): nomor mono besar, judul, garis, label. */
      .chap { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 440px; }
      .chap .num { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 200px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
        color: var(--utama-di-latar); -webkit-text-stroke: 5px var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .chap .ttl { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 120px; }
      .chap .rule { margin-top: 30px; }
      .chap .lbl { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Daftar: prompt $ hijau, baris diketik, garis tipis, centang saat selesai. */
      .head { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 420px; }
      .head .ttl { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 92px; }
      .list { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 820px; }
      .row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 28px; padding: 26px 0; opacity: 0; }
      .row .idx { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 30px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); min-width: 70px; }
      .row .txt { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 70px; line-height: 1.1;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 0.014em currentColor; }
      .row .ok { position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 50%; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-top: -20px; opacity: 0;
        fill: none; stroke: var(--utama-di-latar); stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: square; }
      .row::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--garis); }
      /* Angka: mono raksasa, digit acak lalu terkunci kiri ke kanan. */
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 600px; }
      .val { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 300px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em;
        white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; -webkit-text-stroke: 6px currentColor; }
      .val .dg { display: inline-block; }
      .val .dg[data-s="1"] { color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .val .sfx { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 0.06em; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1;
        padding-top: 0.1em; -webkit-text-stroke: 3px currentColor; }
      .stat .unit { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 100px; }
      .stat .note { margin-top: 44px; font-size: 44px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .stat .note .sel { color: var(--teks); }
      .remind { margin-top: 34px; font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        color: var(--pengingat); }
      .chap .row { margin-top: 26px; padding: 0; }
      .chap .row::after { display: none; }

      /* Tanda tangan di kaki jendela (tetap sepanjang video). */
      #tag { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; bottom: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      #tag .k { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #tag .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 54px; line-height: 1.1; }
      #tag .n small { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 34px; color: var(--teks-redup); margin-left: 16px; }
      #tag .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      #tag .sw i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; outline: 1px solid var(--garis); }
      /* Potongan glitch: empat batang hijau selama 3 frame. */
      #tr .gb { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; background: var(--utama); opacity: 0; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div id="win"><div class="bar"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>

      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: nomor bab dan judul diketik dari karakter acak, garis ditarik, label mono menyusul. -->
      <section class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="chap">
          <div class="num tx">01</div>
          <div class="judul ttl tx">Tuts seret?</div>
          <div class="rule"></div>
          <div class="lbl tx">Catatan rakit · Bengkel Tuts</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Adegan 2, langkah: judul dengan kursor berkedip dan angka diseleksi; tiap baris prompt $ diketik lalu dicentang. -->
      <section class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <div class="head">
          <div class="lbl tx">Langkah servis</div>
          <div class="judul ttl"><span class="tx flow">Cukup <span class="sel">3</span> langkah</span><i class="caret"></i></div>
        </div>
        <div class="list">
          <div class="row"><span class="idx">$</span><span class="txt tx">Cuci semua keycap</span><svg class="ok" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><path d="M5 21l10 10L35 9" /></svg></div>
          <div class="row"><span class="idx">$</span><span class="txt tx">Lumasi 87 switch</span><svg class="ok" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><path d="M5 21l10 10L35 9" /></svg></div>
          <div class="row"><span class="idx">$</span><span class="txt tx">Uji tiap tombol</span><svg class="ok" viewBox="0 0 40 40"><path d="M5 21l10 10L35 9" /></svg></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Adegan 3, angka: digit mono berputar acak lalu terkunci, satuan dan catatan diketik, angka sampel diseleksi. -->
      <section class="scene" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div class="stat">
          <div class="val" id="val"><span class="dg">6</span><span class="dg">2</span><span class="dg">,</span><span class="dg">4</span><span class="sfx">%</span></div>
          <div class="judul unit tx">lebih senyap</div>
          <div class="note tx">Rata-rata · <span class="sel">40</span> papan diuji</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: nama diketik, kontak muncul di baris prompt dengan kursor yang terus berkedip, lalu diam. -->

      // Ketik-acak: tiap huruf muncul sebagai dua karakter acak hijau (0,05 dtk), lalu huruf aslinya. Jeda 0,03 dtk,
      // satu baris paling lama 0,5 dtk. Mengembalikan waktu huruf terakhir terkunci.
      function typeIn(el, t) {
        const cs = chars(el), st = Math.min(0.03, 0.5 / Math.max(1, cs.length - 1));
        cs.forEach((c, i) => {
          const real = c.textContent, ti = t + i * st;
          tl.set(c, { opacity: 1, display: "inline-block", textContent: glyph(), attr: { "data-s": 1 } }, ti);
          tl.set(c, { textContent: glyph() }, ti + 0.05);
          tl.set(c, { textContent: real, attr: { "data-s": 0 } }, ti + 0.1);
        });
        return t + (cs.length - 1) * st + 0.1;
      }
      // Seleksi: latar biru melebar dalam 6 langkah selama 0,3 dtk.
      const select = (el, t) => tl.fromTo(el, { backgroundSize: "0% 100%" }, { backgroundSize: "100% 100%", duration: 0.3, ease: "steps(6)" }, t);
      // Kursor blok berkedip tiap 0,53 dtk.
      function caret(el, t0, t1) { for (let t = t0, k = 0; t < t1; t += 0.53, k++) tl.set(el, { opacity: k % 2 ? 0 : 1 }, t); }
      const rule = (el, t) => tl.fromTo(el, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "power4.inOut" }, t);
      // Baris terminal: prompt $ muncul, teks diketik 0,08 dtk kemudian, centang saat selesai.
      function line(row, t) {
        tl.set(row, { opacity: 1 }, t);
        const end = typeIn($(".tx", row), t + 0.08);
        const ok = $(".ok", row);
        if (ok) tl.set(ok, { opacity: 1 }, end + 0.06);
        return end;
      }
      // Keluar: tiap elemen padam cepat (0,1 dtk) bergantian 0,05 dtk.
      const exit = (els, t) => tl.to(els, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.1, stagger: 0.05, ease: "power4.in" }, t);
      // Potongan glitch: 3 frame adegan bergeser dan miring dengan pecah warna, empat batang hijau melompat, lalu adegan hilang.
      const bars = [0.18, 0.43, 0.61, 0.77].map((y, i) => {
        const b = Object.assign(document.createElement("i"), { className: "gb" });
        b.style.top = y * 1080 + "px"; b.style.height = 12 + i * 9 + "px";
        return $("#tr").appendChild(b);
      });
      function glitch(scene, t) {
        [[26, 6], [-34, -9], [14, 3], [0, 0]].forEach(([x, sk], k) => {
          const at = t + k / 30;
          tl.set(scene, { x, skewX: sk, attr: { "data-g": k < 3 ? 1 : 0 } }, at);
          bars.forEach((b) => tl.set(b, { opacity: k < 3 ? 0.9 : 0, x: (rand() - 0.5) * 530 }, at));
        });
        tl.set(scene, { autoAlpha: 0 }, t + 4 / 30);
      }
      const show = (scene, t) => tl.set(scene, { autoAlpha: 1 }, t);

      // Adegan 1: bab pembuka (0 - 3,0 dtk).
      const s1 = $("#s1");
      show(s1, 0);
      typeIn($(".num", s1), 0.25);
      typeIn($(".ttl", s1), 0.5);
      rule($(".rule", s1), 1.0);
      typeIn($(".lbl", s1), 1.15);
      exit([$(".num", s1), $(".ttl", s1), $(".lbl", s1), $(".rule", s1)], 2.72);
      glitch(s1, 2.88);

      // Adegan 2: langkah (3,3 - 8,2 dtk).
      const s2 = $("#s2");
      show(s2, 3.3);
      typeIn($(".lbl", s2), 3.3);
      typeIn($(".ttl .tx", s2), 3.4);
      caret($(".caret", s2), 3.4, 8.0);
      select($(".sel", s2), 4.0);
      $$(".row", s2).forEach((r, i) => line(r, 4.55 + i * 0.5));
      exit([$(".head", s2), ...$$(".row", s2)], 7.85);
      glitch(s2, 8.03);

      // Adegan 3: angka (8,5 - 11,5 dtk). Digit acak redup tiap 0,05 dtk, terkunci 0,35 dtk + 0,1 dtk per digit.
      const s3 = $("#s3");
      show(s3, 8.5);
      tl.fromTo("#val", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power3.out" }, 8.5);
      $$("#val .dg").forEach((d, i) => {
        const real = d.textContent, lock = 8.85 + i * 0.1;
        for (let t = 8.5; t < lock - 0.001; t += 0.05) tl.set(d, { textContent: String(Math.floor(rand() * 10)), attr: { "data-s": 1 } }, t);
        tl.set(d, { textContent: real, attr: { "data-s": 0 } }, lock);
      });
      typeIn($(".unit", s3), 9.25);
      typeIn($(".note", s3), 9.65);
      select($(".note .sel", s3), 10.45);
      exit([$("#val"), $(".unit", s3), $(".note", s3)], 11.3);
      glitch(s3, 11.45);

      // Adegan 4: ajakan (11,7 dtk), semua terkunci sebelum 13 dtk lalu diam; hanya kursor yang berkedip.
      const s4 = $("#s4");
      show(s4, 11.7);
      typeIn($(".lbl", s4), 11.7);
      typeIn($(".ttl", s4), 11.8);
      rule($(".rule", s4), 12.1);
      line($(".row", s4), 12.2);
      caret($(".row .caret", s4), 12.2, 15);
      typeIn($(".remind", s4), 12.4);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
